a.xlink:title: Start the FSM task.
Task body: block on the queue, hand each line to app_fsm_handle_line().
Handle one received line.
Dispatch one parsed command (READY state only).
Parse one received line.
ALL_ON / ALL_OFF: drive every relay, settle once, verify all, reply.
Send a formatted reply if formatting succeeded.
IN<n>_ON / IN<n>_OFF: drive, settle, verify, reply.
STATUS: read every relay back and reply with one field per channel.
Format the handshake reply "Hello IGNACC v<fw_version> READY\r\n".
Format the reply to an unknown or unsupported command: "UNK_NACK\r\n".
Drive every relay OFF, even if one of them fails.
Drive every relay to the same state, back to back.
Format the result of a relay command.
Check that every relay reads back in the given state.
Wait the relay settle delay (skipped when settle_ms is 0).
Drive a relay ON or OFF.
Turn an snprintf() result into a formatter result.
Read a relay's state back from the hardware.
Read one relay back from the hardware.
Drive one relay.
Format "STATUS IN1=<ON|OFF> ... IN<count>=<ON|OFF>\r\n".
Exact comparison of a length-delimited line with a C string.
Parse IN<n>_ON / IN<n>_OFF.
